name: crakseo-seo-tools
title: CrakSEO SEO Tools
description: Keyword search volume, live Google results and backlink checks from CrakSEO's SEO data API
author: crakseo

commands.name: keyword-volume
commands.title: Keyword Search Volume
commands.subtitle: CrakSEO
commands.description: Monthly Google searches, CPC, keyword difficulty and intent for one or more keywords

commands.name: google-serp
commands.title: Google SERP
commands.subtitle: CrakSEO
commands.description: Live Google results for a keyword, with SERP features and AI Overview sources

commands.name: check-backlinks
commands.title: Check Backlinks
commands.subtitle: CrakSEO
commands.description: Backlinks, referring domains, domain rank and spam score for a domain or URL

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: API Key
preferences.description: Your CrakSEO API key (starts with bidx_key_). Create one at crakseo.com/app/api/keys

preferences.name: country
preferences.title: Country
preferences.description: Two-letter country code of the search market

preferences.name: language
preferences.title: Language
preferences.description: Language code of the search market, for example en or de

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
